title: The Red Umbrella
description: Practice listening to a description of a typical morning routine.
text: It was raining hard. Mia did not have an umbrella. Her friend Tom had a big red one. "Come under here," he said. They walked to school together, laughing in the rain.

title: A New Pet
description: Practice listening to a description of a typical morning routine.
text: Sam wanted a dog. His mom said yes. They went to the shelter. Sam saw a small brown dog. It wagged its tail. "This one," Sam said. He named the dog Buddy.

title: The Lost Key
description: Practice listening to a description of a typical morning routine.
text: Anna could not find her key. She looked in her bag. She looked under the mat. Finally, she found it in her pocket. "There you are!" she laughed, and opened the door.

title: Breakfast Time
description: Practice listening to a description of a typical morning routine.
text: Every morning, Leo eats toast and eggs. Today, he made pancakes instead. He added honey on top. His sister smelled the pancakes and ran into the kitchen. "Can I have some too?"

title: The Bus Stop
description: Practice listening to a description of a typical morning routine.
text: Ben waited at the bus stop. It was cold. He checked his watch. The bus was late. Finally, it arrived. He got on and found a warm seat by the window.

title: A Rainy Weekend
text: It rained all weekend. Kate could not play outside. She read a book instead. Then she baked cookies with her dad. The house smelled sweet. It was a good weekend after all.

title: The New Student
text: A new student joined the class. Her name was Yuki. She was quiet at first. Emma sat next to her and smiled. "Want to be friends?" Emma asked. Yuki nodded happily.

title: Grandpa's Garden
text: Grandpa grows tomatoes in his garden. Every summer, he picks them and shares them with neighbors. Today, he gave a big red tomato to little Jack. "Thank you!" Jack said with a smile.

title: The Missing Sock
text: Ella washed her clothes. After drying them, one sock was missing. She checked everywhere. At last, she found it stuck inside a pillowcase. "Silly sock," she said, and laughed.

title: A Walk in the Park
text: Jake walked his dog in the park. Birds sang in the trees. The dog chased a ball. They sat by the lake and watched the ducks swim. It was a peaceful afternoon.

title: The Job Interview
text: Sarah was nervous about her interview. She had practiced her answers all week, but her hands still shook as she waited in the lobby. When the manager finally called her name, she took a deep breath and walked in confidently. To her surprise, the conversation felt natural, and she left feeling proud of herself, no matter the outcome.

title: A Surprise Visit
text: Daniel hadn't seen his grandmother in almost a year. One Saturday, he decided to surprise her instead of just calling. He drove three hours without telling her he was coming. When she opened the door and saw him standing there, she burst into tears of joy and hugged him tightly for a full minute.

title: The Broken Bicycle
text: On his way to work, Marcus heard a strange clicking sound coming from his bicycle. He stopped to check it and noticed the chain had come loose. With no tools nearby, he had to walk the rest of the way, arriving fifteen minutes late. Luckily, his boss understood and even helped him fix it during lunch.

title: Moving to a New City
text: When Priya moved to a new city for her job, she knew no one. The first few weeks felt lonely and overwhelming. She joined a local hiking group to meet people with similar interests. By the end of the month, she had made several friends and finally started to feel at home.

title: The Coffee Shop Regular
text: Every morning, an elderly man ordered the same coffee at the same table. The staff learned his name, his order, and even his usual jokes. One day, he didn't show up. The barista worried all day until he finally appeared the next morning, explaining he'd simply overslept.

title: A Difficult Decision
text: Tom had two job offers: one paid more, but the other matched his passion. He spent days weighing the pros and cons, talking to friends and family for advice. In the end, he chose the lower-paying job, believing that doing meaningful work mattered more than a bigger paycheck.

title: The Storm
text: Dark clouds gathered quickly over the coastal town. Fishermen rushed to bring their boats to shore before the storm hit. Within an hour, heavy rain and strong winds swept through the streets. By nightfall, the storm had passed, leaving behind fallen branches and a strange, peaceful silence.
